name: BMW R1150GS
engine: 1130 cc oil/air-cooled boxer twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: The classic big GS. Grease the splines, watch the final drive and keep the throttle bodies in sync.

add.title: Lube the drive splines
add.instructions: Pull the rear drive and clean and grease the shaft splines with a moly paste. Look for oil in the swingarm.
add.reason: Dry splines wear and fail. Most owners forget to grease them.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Final drive
known.what: The final drive is a known weak point. Check for oil leaks and listen for whine.
